notes.title: Battleplan: American Civil War Version 1.4 is Now Available!
notes.content:
Patch notes are below:

[list]
    [*]Added Fredericksburg, Seven Pines and Chattanooga battles
    [*]All quick battles are now unlocked without having to play through the campaign
    [*]Units can no longer cross destroyed bridges and pontoons, and those don't block construction of new nearby pontoons
    [*]Fixed messengers occasionally never reaching supply wagons
    [*]Fixed battle achievements not unlocking in quick battles
    [*]Added notification to user if graphics chip doesn't support required OpenGL functionality
    [*]Fixed appearing in corner of screen if running at lower resolutions than desktop
[/list]

Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: Battleplan: American Civil War Version 1.3 is now available!
notes.content:
Patch Note:
[list]
    [*]Limits pontoon positioning, so they can't accidentally be built too close to     one another.
    [*]Enables players to stop pontoon building midway.
    [*]Adds nifty tool tips.
[/list]

Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: Version 1.2 of Battleplan: American Civil War is now available
notes.content:
Version 1.2 of Battleplan: American Civil War is now available!

Update Includes: 

[List][*]Various bug fixes
[*]Enable + and - keys on keyboard allow players to speed up and slow down the game speed, bypassing the pesky Game Options slider
[*]Enable dashboard tab to centre screen for CinC and supply wagons (making them easier to locate)
[*]Allow players the option of using arrow keys to move instead of the WASD keys
[*]Adding on-screen clock timer to edge of battlefield to count down arrival of friendly reinforcements[/List]

notes.title: Version 1.1 of Battleplan: American Civil War is now available.
notes.content:
Version 1.1 of [b]Battleplan: American Civil War[/b] is now available. The update includes:
[list]
    [*]Added Speed Slider to Options Menu – a simple slider in the Options Menu that enables players to dictate both the normal and fast forward gameplay speed (as chosen by clicking or tapping the button in the centre of the timer)
    [*]Updated Confederate flag assets to show the correct number of stars
    [*]Slowed down the speed at which the credits roll[/list]
